start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:recheck-every-ruling-on-its-own-cadence with credential_name <the vault name of my own account database>." It re-measures each ruling that is due and reports three counts; the daily audit runs the same step.
no_lists_because: The rulings are the person's principles rows, read and written in place; no list of the person's is needed.
instructions: 1. Name the vault connection of the database your principles rows are kept in (credential_name).
2. Run the workflow; it measures each ruling with a regression_sql and a ceiling whose cadence is due, and moves its cadence.
3. Read the answer: checked, clean, regressed and unmeasured. A regressed ruling has a calendar task for its owner lane and a last_regressed_why on its row.

worked_examples.title: Re-measure once now
